#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Valheim world (vanilla).
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=./linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export SteamAppID=892970
exec ./valheim_server.x86_64 -nographics -batchmode -logfile "./gamedash-test.log" -name "Test World" -port 2460 -world "TestWorld" -password "${GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD}" -public 0
